evidence.reason: The parser's splitLines treats U+2028, U+2029, U+0085 and other Unicode line-boundary characters as record delimiters. Those characters are legal literal characters inside JSON strings, so a finding whose comment contains one is split into two invalid fragments; the catch at lines 58-65 drops both. That can turn a real finding into a clean receipt when the classification is counted/completed. NDJSON records should be split only on LF/CRLF. This is a routine correctness repair, not a new requirement.
